```python title="Python"

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"bytes": [80, 68, 70, 32, 112, 108, 97, 99, 101, 104, 111, 108, 100, 101, 114], "kind": "bytes", "mime_type": "application/x-unknown"}]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
```
